katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: keine Bekanntmachung oder unzulässige Direktvergabe
katalog.original: Lack of publication of contract notice or unjustified direct award (i.e. unlawful negotiated procedure without prior publication of a contract notice).

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Artificial splitting of works/services/supplies contracts.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: Fristen für Angebote oder Teilnahmeanträge nicht eingehalten
katalog.original: Non-compliance with - time limits for receipt of tenders; or - time limits for receipt of requests to participate; Or Failure to extend time limits for receipt of tenders where significant changes are made to the procurement documents.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: zu kurze Zeit oder Beschränkung beim Zugang zu Unterlagen
katalog.original: Insufficient time for potential tenderers/candidates to obtain tender documentation; Or Restrictions to obtain tender documentation.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: Fristverlängerung nicht bekannt gemacht oder nicht gewährt
katalog.original: Lack of publication of extended time limits for receipt of tenders; Or Failure to extend time limits for receipt of tenders.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: Verhandlungsverfahren oder Dialog nicht gerechtfertigt
katalog.original: Cases not justifying the use of a competitive procedure with negotiation or competitive dialog.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: Eignungs- oder Zuschlagskriterien nicht bekannt gemacht
katalog.original: Failure to publish in the contract notice the selection and/or award criteria (and their weighting); or conditions for performance of contracts or technical specifications; Or Failure to describe in sufficient detail the selection and/or award criteria (and their weighting); Or Failure to communicate/publish clarifications/additional information.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Use of - criteria for exclusion, selection, award; or - conditions for performance of contracts; or - technical specifications that are discriminatory on the basis of unjustified national, regional or local preferences.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Use of - criteria for exclusion, selection, award; or - conditions for performance of contracts; or - technical specifications that are not discriminatory in the sense of the previous type of irregularity (i.e. illegal, disproportionate) but still restrict access for economic operators.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Insufficient or imprecise definition of the subject-matter of the contract.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: fehlende Begründung für Verzicht auf Lose
katalog.original: Lack of justification for not subdividing contract into lots.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: elektronische oder gebündelte Beschaffung nicht regelkonform
katalog.original: Non-compliance with the procedures for electronic and aggregated procurement established in Directive 2014/24/EU.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Unjustified limitation of subcontracting.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: Kriterien nach Angebotsöffnung geändert oder falsch angewandt
katalog.original: Selection criteria (or technical specifications) were modified after opening of tenders or were incorrectly applied.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: Wertung nach abweichenden oder zusätzlichen Kriterien
katalog.original: Evaluation of tenders using award criteria that are different from the ones stated in the contract notice or tender specifications; Or Evaluation using additional award criteria that were not published.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Negotiation during the award procedure, including modification of the winning tender during evaluation.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: wesentliche Änderung der Bedingungen im Verhandlungsverfahren
katalog.original: Competitive procedure with negotiation, with substantial modification of the conditions set out in the contract notice or tender specifications.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: ungerechtfertigter Ausschluss ungewöhnlich niedriger Angebote
katalog.original: Unjustified rejection of abnormally low tenders.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: Interessenkonflikt mit Auswirkung auf das Ergebnis
katalog.original: Conflict of interest with impact on the outcome of the procurement procedure.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Irregular prior involvement of candidates/tenderers towards the contracting authority.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Insufficient audit trail for the award of the contract.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Bid-rigging (i.e. identified by a competition/anti-cartel office).

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Modifications of the contract elements set out in the contract notice or tender specifications, not in compliance with Directive 2014/24/EU.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Vergabe: nationale Regeln für Nicht-Auftraggeber verletzt
katalog.original: Non-compliance with the national rules on procurement carried out by entities other than Contracting Authorities.

katalog.kategorie: 1 Public Procurement - Contract notice and tender specifications
katalog.original: Other (e.g. market consultations not properly documented, incorrect transposition of the public procurement Directives in the national legislation).
Failure to notify State aid.
Wrong aid scheme applied.

katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Beihilfe: Regelung falsch angewandt, nicht berechtigte Unternehmen
katalog.original: Misapplication of the aid scheme, including ineligible beneficiaries/undertaking.
Monitoring requirements not fulfilled.
Reference investment not taken into account in the applicable aid scheme.
No consideration of revenue in the applicable aid scheme.
No respect of the incentive effect of the aid.
Aid intensity not respected.
De Minimis threshold exceeded.

Error in the application of the rules on services of general economic interest (SGEI) (e.g. failure to provide adequate justification for the aid or to demonstrate that the aid is necessary to achieve a legitimate objective of common interest).
Other related to State aid rules (e.g. lack of verification of State aid by the MA/IB in case of re-granting schemes).
Project not eligible.
Project's objective not achieved (including non respect of codes for the types of intervention).
Retrospective projects (Art. 63(6) CPR).

katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Kein Nachweis der Nutzung bei geteilten Investitionen
katalog.original: No evidence about the direct measurement of the use on the project (i.e. for shared investments/equipment between two or more projects).
Other.
Expenditure incurred before or after the eligibility period.
Expenditure not paid by beneficiary.
Expenditure not related the project.
Expenditure outside of the eligibility area (taking into account Art. 63(4) CPR).
Ineligible taxes (e.g. VAT) and costs according to the national legislation.
Ineligible expenditure due to project's objective partially achieved.

katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Erwerb von Grundstücken oder Immobilien regelwidrig
katalog.original: Non-compliance with rules on purchase of land or real estate.
Ineligible beneficiary.
Ineligible participants/final recipient for grant projects/ Ineligible target group.
Conflict of interest (Art. 61 Financial Regulation).
Double financing.

katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Leistung nicht erbracht oder nicht geliefert
katalog.original: Expenditure for works not performed or goods/services not delivered/executed.
Ineligible expenditure incurred due to changes in the project's scope or objectives without obtaining the necessary approvals or amendments to the project's contract.
Ineligible staff expenditure (e.g. incorrect productive hours, incorrect remuneration, unjustified hours in timesheets).
Ineligible expenditure linked to travel and accommodation.
Expenditure noncompliant with specific contractual arrangements and/or with regulations on eligibility requirements (i.e. national or project level).
Irregularities related to a public private partnership.
Other ineligible expenditure (e.g. rounding of monetary amounts/wrong application contractual costs, ineligible expenditure activity returned after payment, etc.).
Wrong methodology.

Wrong application of the methodology (e.g. wrong calculation, wrong input data, wrong adjustment, follow-up error in the application of flat rates), including non-compliance with the conditions for reimbursement.
Non-compliance with the mandatory use of simplified costs.
Failure to fulfill the conditions or failure to achieve the results (Art. 95 CPR).
Non-compliance with the rules for selection of Holding Fund/Specific Fund (direct award by MA or competitive calls).

Lack or incomplete documentation and/or audit trail, cf. Annex XIII CPR (e.g. ex-ante assessment; funding agreements or strategy documents; other documentation supporting the payment applications from final recipients such as business plans or equivalent, including previous annual accounts; checklists and reports at the level of the bodies implementing FIs; etc.).
Ineligible expenditure (e.g. investments, management cost and fees).
Ineligible final recipients.

katalog.kurzbezeichnung: Finanzinstrumente: Zinsen und Rückflüsse regelwidrig verwendet
katalog.original: The interest and other gains generated by support from the Funds and/or re-use of resources attributable to the Funds not used in accordance with Art. 60 and/or 62 CPR.
In case of combination of support with grants in a single FI operation, the conditions of Art. 58(5) CPR were not respected.
Incompatible State aid.
Non-compliance with the information and publicity measures set out in Art. 50 CPR.
Other.

Non-compliance with the responsibilities under Art. 50 CPR (e.g. lack of durable plaques, billboards, poster, communication event, no visible statement highlighting the support on website, documents or communication material).
Missing, incomplete or incorrect supporting information or documentation.
Lack or incomplete audit trail (including due to unreliable IT systems).
Failure to collect information on the beneficial owners of the recipients of Union funding (Art. 69(2) and Annex XVII CPR).

katalog.kategorie: 10 Accounting and calculation errors at project level
katalog.original: Accounting and calculation errors at project level (including at grant level).

katalog.kategorie: 10 Accounting and calculation errors at project level
katalog.original: Failure to keep separate accounting records or failure to use appropriate accounting codes for transactions reimbursed based on costs actually incurred by a beneficiary according to Art. 53(1)(a) CPR.
Incorrect output data.
Incorrect result data.
Non respect of environmental requirements (Natura 2000, Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), Climate proofing).
Non-compliance with the principle of gender equality, equal opportunities and non-discrimination.
Non-compliance with the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union.

Non-compliance with the principle of sound financial management (e.g. poor project management, failure to comply with obligations assumed by the beneficiary, including failure to respect the deadlines for submitting documents, unused cash discounts/reductions).
Non-compliance with the deadline for payment to beneficiaries (80 days, cf. Art. 74(1)(b) CPR).
Non-compliance with the rules of data protection.
